qualityHelp: Applies to JPEG and WebP. PNG is lossless.
autoCapture: Capture immediately when the extension is clicked
autoCaptureHelp: When off, options appear first; press Capture to take a screenshot.
pageInfoBar: Show page title and URL on the screenshot
pageInfoBarHelp: Adds a full-width black bar at the top with the tab title and address on the left.
languageHelp: UI language for UniSS. Default is English.
statusReadyCapture: Ready — press Capture to take a screenshot.
formatHintTip: Output format and quality. Change in Settings.
statusHintTip: Status and next steps appear here.
errCannotCapture: This page cannot be captured (chrome://, about:, store pages, etc.). Open a normal http/https tab.
errImageLoad: Could not load the captured image.
errClipboard: Copying images to the clipboard is not supported in this browser.
errClipboardDenied: Could not copy to the clipboard. Try again or use Download.
errInject: Could not inject a script into the page.
errNoEditImage: No image to edit. Capture from the popup, then press Edit.
statusMove: Drag to move — release to place.
statusTextAdded: Text added. Use Select / Move to reposition.
statusAdded: Added. Use Select / Move or Delete.
aboutBlurb: UniSS captures, annotates, and downloads screenshots on your device. There is no account and no UniSS server.
statusCropping: Crop — drag to move, handles to resize. Enter apply, Esc cancel.
cropHint: Enter apply · Esc cancel · Shift locks aspect
regionPageHint: Select a region or element on the page.
regionInstruct: Hover to snap · click to lock · drag for a free rectangle · Esc cancels
regionWaiting: Waiting for a selection on the page…
errRegionCrop: Could not crop the selected region.
errRegionNoTab: No target tab. Close this page and start Region from the popup.
errRegionStashMissing: Region snapshot expired or missing. Click the UniSS icon and start Region again.
errRegionNeedRestart: Could not show the selector. Click the UniSS icon and start Region again.
errRegionPermission: Page access expired. Click the UniSS icon and start Region again.
regionExportFailed: Could not export the selection. Try again.
